title: Go project implementation and gap map
objective: Map the proposed disclosure and subagent presentation strategy onto the current Go repository, identifying reusable components, missing policy layers, test seams, migration risks, and exact file/symbol touch points.

include: tui, ui, repl, render, loop, types, registry, cost, and session presentation paths
ObservationStore, DetailStore, disclosure levels, activity state, terminal renderer, screen-reader renderer, and Agent result formatting
Existing dirty-worktree changes as read-only current-state evidence
Tests that already lock display or accessibility behavior
exclude: Assuming uncommitted changes belong to this task
Proposing a new dependency unless strictly necessary

deliverables: An as-is architecture and event-to-render data-flow map
A gap list split into reuse, extension, refactor, and unknown categories
acceptance_criteria: Cites exact repository paths and symbols
Distinguishes current behavior from intended behavior and from uncommitted work
Names the smallest viable implementation boundary
verification: Cross-check mappings against current tests and git diff without modifying user files

result.summary: Current Go event-to-render architecture, exact symbol/test traceability, reusable foundations, implementation gaps, and smallest viable boundary.
